description:
## Scope

Foundation crate (jmap-server) backend trait method docs are silent on what to return when account_id does not exist. The handler library validates account existence via JmapBackend::account_exists before calling these methods (bd:JMAP-826m.34) and surfaces accountNotFound itself. But the foundation trait method contract is unspecified for the case where:

- A downstream consumer calls the method directly without going through the standard handler.
- A test fixture constructs a backend without registering accounts and calls these methods.
- A future extension-server handler refactor accidentally drops the pre-check.

In all these cases the trait method's behavior matters. The current trait docs don't say.

Affected methods on JmapBackend (crate-jmap-server/src/backend.rs):

- get_changes (line ~1033)
- get_objects (line ~1017)
- get_state (line ~1026)
- query_objects (line ~1060)
- query_changes (line ~1071-ish)

(account_exists already has the explicit performance-contract paragraph; this bead is about the OTHER trait methods.)

## Recommended doc shape

Mirror the paragraph already added to MetadataBackend::get_metadata_changes (bd:JMAP-ayoz.27, commit pending) at the foundation level:

> # Unknown account_id
>
> The standard JMAP handlers (handle_get, handle_changes, handle_query, handle_query_changes) validate account existence via JmapBackend::account_exists BEFORE invoking this method and surface accountNotFound themselves. Implementations therefore do not need to repeat the account-existence check.
>
> Backends SHOULD return Ok with a wire-shape-appropriate empty result (empty Vec for get_objects, current state with empty change arrays for get_changes / query_changes, empty Vec for query_objects, the zero State for get_state) for an unknown account. Returning Err for unknown accounts is technically valid but surfaces at the wire as serverFail rather than accountNotFound, which is hard to debug.

## Acceptance

- Each of the 5 affected method docs carries the unknown-account paragraph
- cargo doc -p jmap-server -D warnings green
- Per workspace AGENTS.md canonical-template rule, after this lands the same paragraph propagates to extension-server backend trait methods that mirror these signatures (MetadataBackend already done under JMAP-ayoz.27, others tracked).

## Why P4

Pure doc clarification. No behavior change. Backends shipping today rely on the implicit empty-Ok convention via the reference MemoryBackend impls.

## Cross-references

- Driving bead: bd:JMAP-ayoz.27 (closed)
- Related: bd:JMAP-jfia.27 (account_exists performance contract — same trait, different method)
title: jmap-server: document unknown-account behavior on JmapBackend::get_changes / get_objects / get_state / query_objects / query_changes
